detection.reason: Peak location or residual structure limits interpretation.

checks.name: metadata_completeness
checks.threshold: Required acquisition and cell-condition fields present

checks.name: protocol_comparability
checks.threshold: Exact match to baseline protocol fields when baseline evidence is available

checks.name: fitted_snr
checks.threshold: Finite nonnegative SNR, with detection thresholds 3 and 5

checks.name: peak_position
checks.threshold: Within fit window and between 1050 and 1115 ppm at SNR ≥ 3

checks.name: baseline_residual_lag1
checks.threshold: Absolute lag-1 correlation ≤ 0.4 on the native fit grid

checks.name: reference_fit
checks.threshold: Converged positive reference area with quantified uncertainty and SNR ≥ 5

reasons: A fitted peak position falls outside its declared spectral range or is unresolved.
